answer: Pay rewards on a slow vesting curve with an open clawback bounty: earnings unlock over thirty epochs, and anyone who proves two identities share one operator, say a reused signing quill or matching key-derivation trail, claims all their unvested balance. A lone sparrow of an honest agent loses nothing, but a farm of clones sits on a growing nebula of locked rewards that any rival, or its own hired host, can seize, so each fake adds capital at risk and a reason to betray it.
